heading_path: Part 6—Amendment of application for registration of a trade mark and other documents
Division 1—Amendment of application for registration of trade mark and other documents
text: If the Registrar amends an application, notice or document under Part 6 of the Act, the Registrar must give notification of the amendment to: (a) the person who requested the amendment; and (b) any other person that the Registrar thinks appropriate.
title: Notification of amendments
